numeros.h2: We project prudently and show you the whole calculation.
numeros.entradilla: Projected annual return on a 1-bedroom Marlaca IV villa (€165,000) in its first full rental year, 2027. Choose a scenario.
numeros.flujo_etiqueta: From what the villa earns to what you receive
numeros.flujo_nota: For every €100 the villa earns, €35 to €43 reaches you, depending on the scenario. The difference covers booking-platform commissions, day-to-day operations (cleaning, staff, utilities), maintenance and Marlaca's management fee.
numeros.nota_mes: In the conservative scenario you receive €18,159 a year, about €1,500 a month, after all costs and management.
numeros.nota_vistas: 2-bedroom sea-view villa (€260,000): 10.2% · 12.9% · 16.6% depending on the scenario.
numeros.aviso: Before corporate income tax. Not guaranteed. These are projections from the Marlaca IV operating model for 2027. The base scenario is our target; the conservative one is the one we use to decide. We send you the full spreadsheet so you can review every assumption.

gestion.h2: We run the villa. You receive the net and the detail.
gestion.paso1_p: Booking, Airbnb and direct reservations on Marlaca Villas, with rates we adjust daily according to demand.
gestion.paso2_p: Guest reception, cleaning, pool, garden and 24-hour maintenance, with Marlaca staff on the island.
gestion.paso3_p: Occupancy, average rate, income and expenses for your villa, explained line by line.
gestion.paso4_p: We transfer the net result every six months, in January and July, with its report. When you visit the island, the villa is waiting, ready for you.
gestion.fee_texto: Management fee on gross operating profit (GOP). GOP is what remains of the villa's income after platform commissions and operating costs. No hidden costs.

compra.h2: From the first call to the handover of the keys.
compra.pasos_compra1_p: We show you the villas, the construction site and the numbers. If you are in Lombok, you come and see them.
compra.pasos_compra2_p: You choose your villa, we guide you through setting up your company and we sign the sale contract with a notary, in Spanish or English. The whole process can be done remotely.
compra.pasos_compra3_p: Construction takes 12 to 14 months, with a local builder under our daily supervision. You pay 40% on signing, 40% in milestones during construction and the remaining 20% at least two months before the villa is finished, and you receive photos of each stage.
compra.pasos_compra4_p: You receive the villa furnished and ready. From that day it enters management and starts to be rented out.

legal.p: Indonesian law does not allow a foreigner to hold full freehold ownership of land. You therefore buy through a recognised legal structure, which we explain with our notary before you sign. Marlaca runs the villa under a management contract: it rents it out and pays you the net, but it does not own your villa.
legal.item1_dd: PT PMA: an Indonesian foreign-owned company, in your name or shared.
legal.item2_dd: HGB: right to build (Hak Guna Bangunan, HGB) and use the land, for renewable terms.
legal.item3_dd: A notary and local lawyers throughout the process, with documents in English.

preguntas.h2: What people ask us before investing.
preguntas.pregunta1: What title do I hold over the villa?
preguntas.respuesta1: You buy through a PT PMA company that holds an HGB right over the land, which allows you to build on and use the property for renewable terms. It is not full ownership of the land, which Indonesian law reserves for its citizens. We explain it with our notary before you sign.
preguntas.respuesta2: No. We work with three scenarios (11%, 14% and 18% a year, before corporate income tax) and show you the assumptions behind each. What we do have are real results from operating villas, such as Villa Nina in 2025.
preguntas.pregunta3: Can I visit the villas that are already operating?
preguntas.respuesta3: Yes. If you are in Lombok, we show you operating villas and the construction in progress. If not, we do the visit by video call.
preguntas.pregunta4: Can I use the villa myself?
preguntas.respuesta4: Yes. You reserve the dates you want and the villa is rented out the rest of the year. The more nights you use it, the lower the rental result will be.
preguntas.pregunta5: How much does Marlaca charge to manage the villa?
preguntas.respuesta5: 20% of gross operating profit (GOP): what remains of the income after platform commissions and operating costs.
preguntas.respuesta6: 40% on signing the sale contract, 40% in milestones during construction and the remaining 20% at least two months before the villa is finished. A fractional share is reserved with €5,000 and, once the Partnership Agreement is signed, the rest is paid. We send you the payment schedule with the contract.
preguntas.pregunta7: What if I want to invest less than €165,000?
preguntas.respuesta7: You can get in with a fractional share from €36,800: 4% of the company that owns four 2-bedroom villas at Marlaca IV, with a €5,000 reservation and the rest after signing the Partnership Agreement, and you receive your share of the net profit in a six-monthly distribution. It includes a proportional right of use. No fixed return guaranteed.

cookies.meta_descripcion: Which cookies Marlaca Real Estate uses, what they are for, how long they last and how to accept, reject or change your choice.
cookies.intro: Which cookies and similar technologies this website uses, what they are for, and how you can accept them, reject them or change your choice at any time.
cookies.s1_p: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser. Similar technologies, such as local storage (localStorage), serve comparable purposes. They are used to make the website work, to remember your preferences and, if you allow it, to measure how the website is used and how effective our advertising is.
cookies.s2_p: The party responsible for this website and the cookies described here is PT VALENTINA VILLA LOMBOK, an Indonesian limited company (PT) with PMA (foreign investment) status, trading under the Marlaca Real Estate brand. NIB: 0220207151838 · NPWP: 0938 0329 3591 5000. Registered address: Dusun Mengalung, Desa/Kelurahan Kuta, Kec. Pujut, Kab. Lombok Tengah, Provinsi Nusa Tenggara Barat, 83573, Indonesia. Contact: info@marlacarealestate.com.
cookies.s3_p: We use three categories. On your first visit only the technical category is active; the others only if you authorise them.
cookies.s3_tec_p: Essential to remember your cookie choice. They do not require consent and cannot be switched off.
cookies.s3_ana_p: Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC) tells us, in aggregate, which pages are visited and how the website is used. It is loaded only if you accept it.
cookies.s3_pub_p: Meta Pixel and the Conversions API from Meta Platforms measure how our ads on Facebook and Instagram perform. They include an engagement event after 40 seconds of activity and, if you request a call, the sending of that event together with your contact details (email, phone and name) to attribute the conversion; the Conversions API reaches Meta through a server run by our marketing provider. They are loaded only if you accept them.
cookies.s4_p: These are the specific cookies and storage items on this website. Until you accept, no analytics or advertising cookie is installed.
cookies.r1_f: Stores your cookie choice (version and date). It is local storage, not a cookie.
cookies.r2_f: Distinguishes visitors anonymously for Google Analytics statistics.
cookies.r3_f: Maintains the session state in Google Analytics 4.
cookies.r4_f: Identifies the browser to measure Meta ads.
cookies.r5_f: Stores the identifier of the ad click (fbclid); it exists only if you arrive from a Facebook or Instagram ad.
cookies.r6_f: Counts active time on the website for the engagement event (40 seconds). Session storage; only with advertising accepted.
cookies.r7_f: Third-party cookie that Meta may set on its own domain when the pixel loads, if you have a Facebook session or Facebook cookies in your browser.
cookies.s5_p: The analytics and advertising categories mean that Google LLC and Meta Platforms, Inc. process data (for example, your IP address and a browser identifier) in the United States. Both companies are certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, which the European Commission has recognised as providing an adequate level of protection since July 2023. This happens only if you accept those categories.
cookies.s6_t: How to change or withdraw your consent
cookies.s6_p: You can change your choice at any time with the button below or with the “Cookie settings” link in the footer of any page. Withdrawing consent stops tracking and deletes the analytics and advertising cookies that this website is able to remove. You can also delete them in your browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). We will ask for your consent again after 13 months or if the cookies we use change.
cookies.s7_p: If you have any questions, write to us at info@marlacarealestate.com. You can read the cookie guide of the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) and, if you believe we have not handled your data properly, complain to the AEPD (aepd.es) or to your local data protection authority.
